sources.title: Montserrat Immigration: visa-required countries

sources.title: ASAN Visa: countries eligible for e-visa

sources.officialityEvidence: The live Foreign Ministry page defines a named ordinary-passport eVisa cohort, but does not identify Kosovo or state a rule for unlisted passport issuers.

sources.title: Visa regime
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia

sources.title: Yemen eVisa portal: Visit Visa terms
sources.publisher: Immigration, Passports and Nationality Authority, Ministry of Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The live IPNA portal describes approved Visit Visa stickers issued by missions. Its eligibility dataset has no Kosovo record, and this general route therefore cannot establish Kosovo eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The visa sticker is issued to foreigners by embassies and consulates abroad based on Authority approval.

sources.title: Countries requiring a visa for Cabo Verde

sources.supportingExcerpt: If you cannot find your country on this list, please contact the nearest Cabo Verdean embassy.

sources.officialityEvidence: The official Ministry eVisa service describes tourist eVisa approval and arrival stamping but its named eligible-country information does not directly classify Kosovo.
